This '''planet''' was located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of an [[Stauz Czycz's species|alien species]] that were razed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. [[Stauz Czycz]] was the only one to survive the Imperial destruction.
